title: The Tide Vault
solution: THE ASTRONOMER IS SAFE IN THE TIDE VAULT. OPEN THE BLUE CASE. THE STAR MAP PROVES THE LANTERN SIGNAL WAS A WARNING.
ciphertext: CEI PRCKDFDOIK AR RPUI AF CEI CAGI SPVNC. DXIF CEI HNVI QPRI. CEI RCPK OPX XKDSIR CEI NPFCIKF RAMFPN TPR P TPKFAFM.
briefing: Inside the tide vault, a blue case rests below a chart of the stars. One final message explains the astronomer's disappearance. Piece together what the lantern was telling you.
ending: Dr. Vale steps from the vault. Her star map and the keeper's tide records reveal submerged rocks in the old shipping route. The lantern was a warning, not a distress signal. Together you relight the harbor beacon and guide the waiting boats safely home. The missing astronomer is found, and the mystery is solved.
clues: CEI appears 5 times as a whole word. Start with it and reuse story words: ASTRONOMER, TIDE VAULT and BLUE CASE.
This is a new substitution alphabet; guesses from the archive will not carry over. The first sentence reads THE ASTRONOMER IS SAFE IN THE TIDE VAULT.
Cipher C is T, E is H, and I is E. The final five words read LANTERN SIGNAL WAS A WARNING.
